tokens.name: bedrock
tokens.usage: The deepest layer: the terminal pane background. Only the terminal sits on bedrock. With a Ghostty theme, it is the theme's background.

tokens.name: horizon-o
tokens.usage: Window chrome: the tab bar and the pane header. With a Ghostty theme, it steps from the theme background: lighter in Night, darker in Day.

tokens.name: horizon-a
tokens.usage: Panel ground: the plot panel, sheets, the review list. Steps from the theme background like horizon-o.

tokens.name: horizon-b
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the quick switcher, popovers, menus, a hovered row. Steps from the theme background like horizon-o.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions (sidebar edge, tab separators, split dividers). Decorative only: never the only edge of a control. Steps from the theme background.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The ground behind the glass sidebar and the toolbar row. Night: bedrock. Day: horizon-o, so the edge of the glass shows. Follows the Ghostty theme the same way.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Control borders and input outlines. At least 3:1 on horizon-a and horizon-b in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bedrock, horizon-o, horizon-a and horizon-b. With a Ghostty theme, it takes a low-chroma tint of the theme hue and reaches 4.5:1 on each of them.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (notes, meta, timestamps) on every surface. At least 5.6:1 in Loam's own themes. With a Ghostty theme, it takes the same tint and is lifted until it reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels, the Plots section label. Below 4.5:1: only for 10.5px+ labels or text that is not needed to act. With a Ghostty theme, it takes the same tint and reaches 3:1.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The brand hue: the active plot, the selected tab underline, the primary button, links you can open. Text-safe on every surface. With a Ghostty theme, the hue stays and only the lightness moves, as far as 4.5:1 on each text surface needs.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moss fill (primary button).

tokens.name: moss-wash
tokens.usage: The selected row in the sidebar and the switcher. Ink reads on it.

tokens.name: needs-you
tokens.usage: The Needs you state: a session waits on your answer. Filled dot, the count badge, the pane banner edge. With a Ghostty theme, the hue stays and only the lightness moves, as far as 4.5:1 on each text surface needs.

tokens.name: needs-you-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of the Needs you banner and badge. needs-you text reads on it.

tokens.name: done-unread
tokens.usage: The Done, unread state: a session finished a turn you have not seen. Hollow ring, never a filled dot. With a Ghostty theme, the hue stays and only the lightness moves, as far as 4.5:1 on each text surface needs.

tokens.name: done-unread-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a done, unread chip.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: Delete plot, Undo and overwrite, a missing link path. With a Ghostty theme, the hue stays and only the lightness moves, as far as 4.5:1 on each text surface needs.

tokens.name: rust-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of an error banner. rust text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 5.8:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Terminal and text selection background.

duration.note: Motion is short and physical. Nothing loops except the Needs you halo.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, dot state changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Row select, tab switch, a panel section reveal.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Switcher open, a sheet in, a plot settling into the sidebar.

tokens.name: duration-halo
tokens.usage: One Needs you halo cycle. It stops when the pane gets focus.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Things that arrive: the switcher, sheets, a new change row. A fast start and a soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-lift
tokens.usage: Things that leave: a closed sheet, an undone change folding away.
